name: tinkery
description: Vj Anma's tinkery — a personal workshop of Claude Code plugins: skills tinkered into existence, published for anyone to use.

plugins.name: video-to-prd
plugins.description: Turn a screen-recording video (local file or YouTube link) into an implementation-ready Product Requirements Document using scene-detection screenshots and audio transcription.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Guide significant decisions with the research-backed COMPASS framework (Clarify, Options, Measure, Pause, Anticipate, Settle, Score) — an interactive walkthrough or a fillable worksheet.

plugins.name: branding
plugins.description: Agency-grade naming and brand-identity workflow: multi-angle brainstorm, web validation, expert-panel scoring on a weighted rubric, then full brand directions and guidelines.

plugins.name: storybrand
plugins.description: Clarify a company's marketing message using Donald Miller's StoryBrand framework (SB7, StoryBrand 2.0): BrandScripts, one-liners, controlling ideas, and website/pitch audits.
